formation: Supply only the expression and explicitly declared assumptions from the four TRAIN seedExpressions; synthesize opaque sequential IDs. No task IDs, evaluation expressions/targets, demonstration endpoints or held-out assumption combinations reach formation. Freeze all twelve selections and hashes before evaluation. Never use inferred or newly introduced assumptions in place of the supplied context.
grammarDefinition: Three nonempty subsets of two genuine production rational-normalization forms in the order shown. CANCELLATION enables only the existing root quotient common-factor operation. EQUAL_DENOMINATOR enables only the existing sum/difference of two equal-denominator quotients. COMBINED uses the unchanged operator enabling both. Custom leaf substitution, unconditional cancellation, relaxed equivalence rules and arbitrary formula templates are outside this finite grammar.
production: One proposal of the actual unmodified combined production operator. Use RationalAssumptionRewriteAdapter.formCandidate, its exact field-equivalence check under the supplied assumptions, nonempty candidate assumptions and strict reduction in canonicalizer AST node cost on every accepted TRAIN witness.
enumeration: Propose each of the three grammar members once in the registered order. Validate through the same real adapter using only the member's permitted production operator forms. Retain the first member supported by all four TRAIN seeds. Continue to record remaining proposals, rejections and resource consumption.
random: Draw three times with replacement from the same three ordered grammar members using java.util.Random.nextInt(3). One stream per campaign from the first 64 bits, big endian, of the existing rational #383 seed digest including benchmarkId. Actually re-execute duplicates and retain them. Freeze the first member supported by every TRAIN seed. Never replace an empty arm or refit after selection.
allowances: Every arm has up to three grammar proposal slots and the same cumulative 60 states / 60 candidate validations during formation. Debit all attempts against that ledger without resets. A one-member production proposal leaves two slots unused. For legacy adapter fail-fast behavior retain supported witnesses, actual consumption and failing reason. SEARCH_MAX_DEPTH=5. Each of twelve unchanged tasks receives the original 245-state / 45-candidate budget. A campaign total is at most 3000 states and 600 candidate validations. No solver/proof calls.
evaluation: Use the same existing RationalAssumptionRewriteAdapter BFS with the frozen grammar member, depth and allowances, the same two base primitives (square-difference factorization and division by one) and unchanged exact AST target criterion. The independent rational-field verifier checks every considered edge against task premises and checks the final exact source/target equality and domain. Retain every actual task award, unsupported/no result, refutation, exhaustion or no-candidate row, all selected transitions, obligations, arithmetic normal forms, seed, attempts and actual counts. No invented successes for unreachable reference syntax.
controls: Public component checks run separately from the comparison: direct cancellation with and without the divisor guard, unlike/like denominators, addition and subtraction, candidate guards, and strict AST reduction for admitted examples. No control outcome feeds arm formation or evaluation.
claimBoundary: Finite diagnostic of building an executable operator subset from visible exemplars on a public previously evaluated panel. Class-level program enumeration is genuine, but three grammar members do not represent unrestricted symbolic discovery. Actual work may differ within identical declared ceilings. The comparison does not prove external novelty, universal superiority, total compute parity or safety outside the confirmed rational-field fragment.
